user_prompt: Projects: [20-project shortlist — same as Claude runs]
raw_response:
My winner is **PolicyEngine**.

As a practitioner building sensitive systems for UK government, PolicyEngine's open-source, transparent modelling of tax and benefit policy is an exemplary case of responsible AI that is directly applicable to my work. It embodies AI safety through built-in interpretability, allowing for rigorous public scrutiny of high-stakes government decisions. This project isn't just a framework or a consultation tool; it is a concrete, auditable system for mitigating the systemic risks of opaque AI in a core public sector domain.
